Applications

Laser Cutting for Fabrication Shops

Laser cutting is useful when a part needs accurate profiles, complex contours, internal cutouts or cleaner edges before bending and fabrication. Buyers use this service for both trial parts and repeat batches.

Fabrication Blanks

Cut blanks for brackets, frames, covers, plates, flanges, machine guards, enclosure parts and assembly components.

Accurate Profiles

Useful for complex shapes, internal cutouts, slots and parts where clean edges reduce finishing work before welding or assembly.

Complete Flow

Laser cutting can be combined with CNC punching, sheet bending, bar bending and fabrication when the part needs multiple processes.

Common questions

Before Sending a Laser Cutting Job

What file should I send?

A DXF or CAD drawing is best. If that is not ready, send a sketch or part photo with dimensions, material, thickness and quantity.

Can you cut and bend the same part?

Yes. If the part needs bending after laser cutting, tell us the finished size and bend direction so the blank can be planned properly.

What parts are suitable?

Brackets, plates, covers, profiles, panels, enclosure blanks, machine guards and fabrication components are common laser cutting requirements.
